meta.name: epic-hypothesis
meta.description: Frame an epic as a testable hypothesis with target user, expected outcome, and validation method. Use when defining a major initiative before roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning.

copy.tagline: 将史诗级需求转化为可验证的假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将大型需求拆解为可验证的假设来指导产品方向。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn large initiatives into testable hypotheses to guide product direction.

howto.what: 将你的创意或大型任务转化为一个可验证的假设，包含目标用户、预期结果和验证方法。它会引导你填写“如果……那么……”结构，并设计轻量实验来检验假设。
howto.when: 当你需要定义一项重大计划（如新功能或项目），但尚未确定路线图或开始开发时。通常在规划前使用。

say.text: 把“添加用量警报”做成一个史诗假设。
say.note: 技能会帮你构建假设结构。

say.text: 帮我为“优化注册流程”写一个史诗假设。
say.note: 技能会引导你填写目标用户和验证方法。

howto.what_en: Transforms your initiative or epic idea into a testable hypothesis with target user, expected outcome, and validation method. Guides you through an if/then structure and lightweight experiments to test assumptions before committing to full build.
howto.when_en: When defining a major initiative (e.g., new feature or project) before roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning. Use it early to frame epics as hypotheses.

say_en.text: Frame 'adding usage alerts' as an epic hypothesis.
say_en.note: The skill will build the if/then structure.

say_en.text: Create an epic hypothesis for 'optimizing signup flow'.
say_en.note: The skill will guide you through target user and validation.
